# Picker

`Markup.picker`: a fuzzy picker in a popup.

## markup.picker

Source: `lua/markup/picker.lua`

### markup.picker.filter()

```lua
function markup.picker.filter(items: markup.picker.item[], query: string)
  -> { item: markup.picker.item, positions: integer[] }[]
```

Items matching a query, best first, with the positions that matched.

### markup.picker.highlight()

```lua
function markup.picker.highlight(label: string, positions?: integer[])
  -> markup.picker.span[]
```

Splits a label into runs, marking the characters a query matched.

### markup.picker.open()

```lua
function markup.picker.open(opts: markup.picker.opts)
  -> { close: function }
```

## markup.picker.item

Source: `lua/markup/picker.lua`

Fields:

- `keywords`: `string?` - matched as well, but never shown, such as an id
- `label`: `string` - what is shown and matched, with matches highlighted
- `prefix`: `markup.picker.span[]?` - before the label
- `suffix`: `markup.picker.span[]?` - at the end of the row
- `value`: `any`

## markup.picker.opts

Source: `lua/markup/picker.lua`

Fields:

- `click`: `("double"|"single"|false)?` - which click picks a row, single by default
- `empty`: `string?` - shown when nothing matches
- `height`: `integer?` - rows of the list, 15 by default
- `items`: `markup.picker.item[]`
- `on_select`: `fun(value: any, item: markup.picker.item)`
- `title`: `string?`
- `width`: `integer?` - 80 by default

## markup.picker.span

Source: `lua/markup/picker.lua`

Fields:

- `[1]`: `string` - text
- `[2]`: `string?` - highlight
